title: Ledger event (chapter 9)
description: One JSONL line. Events are appended, never updated; a later fact about a decision is a new event carrying the same decision_id.

payload.description: Secret-looking keys are replaced with [redacted] on the way in. No API keys, signatures, Authorization headers or wallet secrets.

previous_event_hash.description: The preceding event's event_hash; sha256:000...0 for the first event.

event_hash.description: RFC 8785 canonical form of this event without event_hash, then SHA-256.
